validation.revokedIf: any code, test, harness, fetch policy, migration or methodology implementation change becomes necessary; none did here

nextAuthorisedActionNaming: the landed replacement-bearing windows name a PRE_NETWORK_LEDGER_APPEND_AND_LIVE_EXECUTION action because they assign a reserve first. This window is primaries-only and has no append stage, so the segment is absent, matching the landed primary-only precedents

afterCleanChildWindowBAdjudication.ifCanonicalSuccessesReach50: STOP SUCCESSFULLY and report P6_SUCCESS_FLOOR_REACHED; do not begin replacements and do not append reserve 10
afterCleanChildWindowBAdjudication.ifBelow50AndNoPauseFired: continue automatically to child window C (P:51-P:55) under the bound continuation decision, with its own strategy, plan and live authority
afterCleanChildWindowBAdjudication.ifAnyPauseFired: STOP the continuation; window C is not started; a second pause requires another owner review
